a:

there are a number of issues with your question.

XXXXX starts on sunday, no one can be the monday of the first XXXXX
XXXXX starts on monday, no one can be the first monday of the second XXXXX
XXXXX starts on monday and ends on sunday, no one can be the second sunday of the second XXXXX
XXXXX starts on monday and ends on sunday, no one can be the second sunday of the third XXXXX
etc.

i'll address these issues first.
XXXXX starts on sunday:
first, the current XXXXX begins on sunday.
therefore, sunday is the first day of the XXXXX.
second, sunday is the only day of the XXXXX that has a value of 1, hence there is not a XXXXX.
since XXXXX starts on sunday:

first day of the XXXXX is sunday
for every other day of the XXXXX, there is exactly one day of the XXXXX that it is a monday
